fields.Name: T162 - Operate Model Dialog
fields.Description: Exercises the PSOperateDialog (scope/output segmented controls + live summary + create-scoring-process wiring) — a distinct deploy/run dialog with no generic equivalent.

InputDefinition.goal: In the Predictive Studio app, open the 'Models' door → 'Models in Production' section. Pages can take 10-30s to load — wait, don't navigate away. If a published model is present, select it and click its 'Operate' (rocket) button. Success is the 'Operate' dialog opening with: a fixed target-entity callout, a 'Which records?' scope segmented control (Everyone / A saved view / A list), a 'Where do predictions go?' output segmented control (Run history only / Write back to a column), a live summary line, and 'Run now' / 'Schedule…' buttons. Toggling the scope or output segments should update the controls/summary. If there are no published models to operate, confirming the production empty state renders is a pass. You do NOT need to actually run or schedule.

judgeValidationCriteria: Clicking 'Operate' opens a dialog with scope and output segmented controls plus Run now / Schedule buttons, OR the production empty state is shown (no models to operate)
Toggling the scope segment (Everyone / view / list) or output segment changes the dialog's shown controls or summary
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
